channel.title: Escape to the Country
channel.desc: Briony May Williams is in beautiful Pembrokeshire to help a buyer from Leeds who is following her intuition, with a budget of ?250,000, to start a brand new chapter in Wales. Having only visited Pembrokeshire once before, she's drawn to the county's spiritual pull and stunning landscapes. Briony also meets a couple who have created their own green dream with an eco-glamping site in the amazing Pembrokeshire countryside.
